title: 4.13 Months: January to June
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Name the first six months of the year and say which month it is.
grammar_function: It is + month; What month is it? It is + month.
prerequisite: 2.4 What is it? and It is; 4.9 the days and What day is it today?; 4.12 month, months, year.
speaking_outcome: Ask What month is it? and answer It is March.
